regions.today: Cloudy for most this evening with patchy rain in places. Brighter spells developing from the south.
regions.tonight: A mix of cloud and clear spells, and just the odd spot of light rain or drizzle. There will be some coastal and hill mist and fog too, mainly in the southeast. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees, with light southerly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy to start with patches of light rain and drizzle. Brighter in the afternoon with scattered rain developing. Mist and drizzle arriving on southern coasts in the evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees, with light to moderate south to southwest winds.
